milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dandelion is placed at spawn-relative (4, 0, 3) on the grass field. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actively walked toward it (player spawns at origin, dandelion is ~5 blocks away, so they must move and face it). facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional visual identification rather than accidental triggering.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The pink bed head is at spawn-relative (10, 1, 10) inside the oak planks shelter. max_distance=5 requires the player to have entered or be at the entrance of the shelter (the bed is ~14 blocks from spawn, so the player must navigate there). facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the bed, confirming visual identification.
